div.l: Her knyves were nought chapud with Brasse
But alle with syluer wrought full clene and wele
Her gurdels and her powches eủerydele
Well semed yche of hem a Feyre Burgesse
To sytte in a yeldehalle on a deys
Eủeryche for the wysdom̄ þat he kan̄
Was schaply to ben̄ an alderman̄
For goode had þey y nowh and rente
And eke her wyves wold þ̉erto assent
And elles certeyn̄ þey were to blame ·
Hyt ys full feyre to be clepud madame
And gone to vygylyes alle byfor͗
And haue a mantel ryally y bor͗
¶ A Cooke they had with hem for þe nones
To Boyle the Chykon̄s with þe mary bones
And pouder Marchaunt tart and Galyngale
Well kowde he knowe a draught of gode london Ale
He kowde Roste sethe Brroyle and frye
Make mortreux and well bake a pye
But harme hit was as thought me
That on his schyn̄ a Marmole had he
For Blankemaunger þat made he wᵗith þe best
A Schipman̄ was þ̉er wonynge ferr͗ by west
For ought y wotte he was of dertemouth
He Rode vp on A Rounsy as he kowth
In a goune of faldynge vn to þe kne ·
A dager hangynge in a lase had he
Aboute his nek vnder his Arme a doun̄
The hete somer had made his hewe al broun̄
And certeynly he was a a gode felawe
Full many a draught of wyne had he drawe
From Burdeux ward while þe m̉erchauntȝ slepte ·
